description: Every arbitrary probability and parameter of the randomizer. Each entry is {"value": ..., "description": ...}; edit the value, keep the description up to date. Loaded and checked by core/game/data/tuning.py.

boot_heaps.description: The heap sizes at boot for each application memory size in MB (80 on an Old 3DS, 124 on a New 3DS; game/executable/memory_boot.py), in KB, whole 4 KB pages. Global, CommandCache, Unit/Area and Develop: those heaps' sizes (the game's: 768, 768, 7168, 100; their highest use over 186 save states, 'Measured: M1': Global 410 online, CommandCache 430, Unit/Area 6001 online and 5775 offline, Develop 0; on 80 MB M1's sizes: Global 0.625 MB, CommandCache 0.5, Unit/Area 6.75). root_margin_kb: what the root heap keeps free after the boot, above what the game takes from it then (the ported monsters' objects in a hunt, and what that measure may have missed). Resource (the game's 48128 on an Old 3DS, 53248 on a New 3DS) gets everything left, up to resource_max_kb; a build whose executable leaves it under resource_min_kb stops (on 80 MB: the size at which the 1.36 MB buffer Gogmazios' event unpacks on re-entry fits). The packs' budget is no number here: each build keeps its run's packs out of the root heap, uncommitted (on 80 MB the most its packs' loader commits at once, game/executable/pack_loader.py run_need; on 124 MB, where the packs' manager does not exist, every pack, read at boot and kept: resident_need). On 124 MB this row is all that stays of the manager: sizing the heaps at boot costs no loading time, and with the game's 52 MB of Resource some ported monsters' pairs and randomized quests would not fit. Every built executable gets them; any other memory size keeps the game's numbers.

ext_margin_pages.description: The extension's room for new code (game/executable/code_space.py EXT_SIZE): the 4 KB pages EXT_SIZE keeps over what the layout's blocks take. Each page costs a page of the Old 3DS heaps in every build that has the extension's variables (they start after EXT_SIZE). When the blocks outgrow EXT_SIZE, tools/build/build_code_space.py names the EXT_SIZE to write: the blocks' pages plus these.

scene_gate_frames.description: The frames (10 seconds at 60) the scene gate holds the loading screen after a quest at most while it waits for the quest's last units to be deleted and the network's calls into the ported monsters' machinery to end (core/monsters/porting/pack_loader.c scene_gate). Past it the gate lets the town start and keeps the packs loaded: no crash, only the memory stays taken until the next quest's load.

ram_log.description: The Debug tab's RAM log (diagnostics/memory_diag.c): timer_frames, a memory row every this many frames presented (150: 5 seconds at the game's 30), each followed by a write of the new rows to the SD card's file; rows_per_write, the most rows (64 bytes each) one write takes, so a write never holds the frame long (a quest load's hundred rows go in one). Whole numbers above 0.

target_marker_priority.description: Aspect ratio option: the draw priority of the target marker (ui211_target, 0x13 in the game); above the item bar's 0x17, which the wider picture moves out to the corner, so the marker is never drawn under it (cheats/aspect_ratio.py MARKER_SITE). A whole number 0 to 255; the HUD's panels run 0x14 to 0x17.

talk_window_quest_modes.description: HUD size: the game modes (the game control's byte +0x2B, 0 to 31: 1 a quest, 5 its results, 2 the Gathering Hall) in which the talk windows shrink with the HUD; in every other mode (the villages, the Gathering Hall) they keep their full size (interface/hud/code_patch.py patch_talk_size).

coplanar.description: Felyne helms: a helm surface this close (skeleton unit) to a sample of the base's eyes or ears shares its depth with it and wins or loses pixels frame by frame; the converter sinks such a surface. The depth buffer settles about 0.001, the test checks 0.05.

parallel.description: Felyne helms: a surface near an eye or ear sample only shares its depth with it over an area when it faces the same way: the cosine of the angle between the two surfaces' normals is at least this (0.8 is about 37 degrees). A surface that crosses an eye or an ear at a steeper angle meets it along a line and is left alone.

extra_sinks.description: Felyne helms: the depths (same unit), tried in this order, by which a surface that lies within 'coplanar' of the eyes or ears is moved behind its front; the first that clears every sample is kept.

head_lifts.description: Felyne helms that show the base head's skin: the depths (same unit), tried in this order, by which a surface of the helm that hugs the head (within 'coplanar') is moved in front of its own surface so it stops sharing its depth with the head; the first that clears every sample is kept, none: the one that left the fewest. Each step swells the mesh a little: a longer list clears more helms and bends their hair more.

quest_end_skip_speed.description: Cheat 'Skip Quest End Timer' (cheats/quest_timers/quest_timers.py): how many times faster the countdown after a quest's end runs while A and B are held (the Gateway code's 8; from 1 to 64).
